proposition: Prince Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh, a calligrapher, was the Timurid prince most interested in Ibn Turka's lettrism; Ibn Turka's R. Suʾl al-Mulūk was written at his request, and Muḥammad Ṭūsī dedicated a censure of Fażl Allāh to him.

mediation.note: the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk is MK's Chapter 2 §2.1.2 no. 40; not read
